blocks.text: Asean leaders gather at Coconut Palace for summit retreat MANILA, Philippines — Leaders of the Asean member states proceed to the newly renovated Coconut Palace in Pasay City for the 49th Asean Summit Retreat session. It is a private meeting where heads of state can freely discuss important regional and global issues and share their views in a more relaxed setting, away from formal speeches and ceremonies. /dl LIVE UPDATES: Asean Summit 2026 and related meetings – Nov. 14, 2026...
